eidolons.name: Who Giggled at the Primordial Hush?
eidolons.desc: When entering combat, immediately gains 5 "Wishpower." When Aeon ★ Aha is present, Elation DMG dealt by all ally targets merrymakes by 15%.

eidolons.name: A Stacked Deck of Sorrow and Joy
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: A Joke's Fate Boxed in Black
eidolons.desc: The multiplier of the True DMG dealt by Elation Skill increases by 25% of its original value. When Aeon ★ Aha deals Elation DMG, an additional 100% of the total "Certified Banger" held by teammates will be taken into account.

eidolons.name: Moi Onstage and Me Offstage
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: For THEY Said: You Are Elation
eidolons.desc: Enemy targets always carry an "Elation Debt" effect that claims at least 20% of their Max HP. After Aeon ★ Aha uses Ultimate for the first time, Aha's action advances by 100%, and Aha gains 100 Punchline.

basic.name: Starfrost, Showtime!
basic.desc: Deals {0}% Quantum Elation DMG to one designated enemy target.

skill.name: This Emanator Was Certified by Aha™
skill.desc: Enables one designated ally character (excluding this unit) to gain the "Emanator of Elation" state, then immediately launches Follow-up ATK, dealing {1}% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. The "Emanator of Elation" state lasts for the entire battle until it switches to the next target. The target with the "Emanator of Elation" state has their Elation stat increased by {0}% and, at the start of their turn, enables Aeon ★ Aha to gain 1 point(s) of "Wishpower."

ult.name: Aha! Let There Be Laughter
ult.desc: Aha's action advances by 20%. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state, lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Aeon ★ Aha's every turn. Deals {0}% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals 5 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing {1}% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.

talent.name: Work Wonders with THEM
talent.desc: Can activate Ultimate after "Wishpower" reaches 8. After reaching its upper limit, Wishpower can still overflow up to 10. After using Basic ATK, Skill, or Elation Skill, Aeon ★ Aha gains 1 "Wishpower." After allies' Punchline reaches 40 for the first time, Aeon ★ Aha will immediately gain 1 "Wishpower" and then increase all allies' CRIT DMG by {0}%, lasting for 3 turn(s). This can trigger again after Aha's turn ends.

extra.name: Yes Aha At Full Moon
extra.desc: Always gets used at the end of Aha Instant regardless of Participant ID. Deals {0}% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and deals True DMG based on 20% of total non-True DMG dealt by ally targets during this Aha Instant, distributed evenly among all enemies.

extra.name: Faces of Elation ★ Ex Nihilo
extra.desc: While holding the "Faces of Elation" state, Aeon ★ Aha enables allies' Path of Elation to ascend, and enhances Punchline and "Certified Banger" into Bliss and "Party Trick," respectively. Bliss recovers 10% of its consumed amount when Aha Instant ends. During "Faces of Elation," Aeon ★ Aha's CRIT Rate increases by {1}%, and the DMG dealt ignores {0}% of the enemy target's DEF.

extra.name: The True Story of Aha
extra.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha or a teammate deals DMG, additionally applies the "Elation Debt" effect onto the enemy target, equal to 25% of their HP loss. Elation Debt persists through the enemy target's phase transition, capped at 10% of the target's Max HP.

technique.name: ABRACADABRA!
technique.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension around this unit, lasting for 20 second(s). Enemies within this Special Dimension get inflicted with "Optical Illusion." Once inflicted with "Optical Illusion," they cannot detect ally targets. After entering combat, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of 20 Punchline is taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchline. Only 1 dimension effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ability_1.name: A Prank on Aeons
ability_1.desc: Skill's Follow-Up ATK additionally deals 20% Elation DMG of the same Type as the target who holds the "Emanator of Elation" state, and recovers 1 Skill Point(s). This additionally dealt Elation DMG is not considered as an instance of attack.

ability_2.name: A Carnival in Whimsy
ability_2.desc: When receiving healing or a Shield provided by a teammate, gains 1 "Wishpower." This can be triggered up to 1 time(s). The trigger count resets after the Ultimate is used.

ability_3.name: A Box of Everything
ability_3.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha's SPD reaches 125/150 or higher, the Elation stat increases by 120%/150%, respectively. When combat starts, own action advances by 30%.

extra.name: The True Story of Aha
extra.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha or a teammate deals DMG, additionally applies the "Elation Debt" effect onto the enemy target, equal to 25% of their HP loss. Elation Debt persists through the enemy target's phase transition, capped at 10% of the target's Max HP.

lightCones.name: Upon the First Echo of "Aha"
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's base SPD by 12/14/16/18/20. When using Skill on one other ally, gains 10/12/14/16/18 Punchline. This effect can trigger at most once after a gap of every 1 turn(s). Then, enables all allies to ignore 16%/18%/20%/22%/24% of the enemy target's DEF when they deal DMG during this battle. This effect cannot be stacked.

lightCones.name: Mushy Shroomy's Adventures
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Elation by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 6%/7%/8%/9%/10% for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Elation Brimming With Blessings
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, increases the target's Elation stat by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24% for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Tomorrow, Together
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases all allies' Elation by 8%/9%/10%/11%/12%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Dreamlit Actor
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases SPD by 6%. 4-pc: When the wearer uses their Skill or Ultimate on one other ally target, increases the ability target's Elation by 16%, lasting for 3 turn(s). If the wearer has 10 or more points of Certified Banger, additionally increases all ally targets' CRIT DMG by 12%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Diviner of Distant Reach
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases SPD by 6%. 4-pc: Before entering combat, if the wearer's SPD is greater than or equal to 120/160, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 10%/18%. When the wearer uses Elation Skill for the first time in each battle, increases all allies' Elation by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

planarSets.name: God's Moment of Joy
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer's Elation stat reaches 40% or higher, advances the wearer's action by 40% immediately upon entering combat.

planarSets.name: Sprightly Vonwacq
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's action is Advanced Forward by 40% immediately upon entering battle.

teams.name: Aha Elation Team
teams.description: Aha feeds Punchline and Elation to Silver Wolf LV.999, who carries the damage. Yao Guang stacks more Elation buffs on top and Pearl keeps the team alive. Sparxie, Evanescia or the Elation Trailblazer can take Silver Wolf LV.999's place.

teams.name: Aha Waveflair Team
teams.description: A double-carry setup: Aha speeds up and buffs Aventurine • Waveflair and Ashveil, and the team-wide DEF ignore from Aha's signature cone helps both of them. Hyacine handles the healing.

lore.description:
Cries and comedy intertwine, and the deathly still cosmos awakens to daybreak in a farce.
Stepping back onto the stage of the Path, I tear off the god's mask. Who is Aha? I am Aha!
To play, to trick, to hunt... Please bear witness to an improv tour where humans and gods dance as one!
stories: "Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Aha's Theater!" The Fool pulls back the stage curtains. "Fool of the stars, Actor of the cosmos, comic artist of Elation... What exactly is this Aha you speak of?" the Actor asked, with a melancholy air. "It's simple. 'Aha' is nothing more than a sigh from a god toying with the galaxy." The comic artist finally showed up, latest work in tow. "Don't believe me? Then feast your eyes. The secrets and entanglements between THEM and the Aeons that shouldn't be missed—" Pages of sketches flutter down into the audience's hands, and the theater erupts in gleeful laughter. "...The protagonist this time is Lil' Ha, and Lil' Ha is a master at roping people into THEIR shady schemes. Walking toward us right now are Stone Hero Amberhead and Captain Cosmos Ena... Wait, what!? Even Goddess Xipe got duped into joining Lil' Ha's Bug-Busting Alliance!? No! This is just a smokescreen by Lil' Ha, a classic bait-and-switch to kill two birds with one stone. Look! THEIR true target is the restless Evil God Voracity... Lil' Ha and Aki suppressed the Evil God Voracity together once again, leaving Goddess Xipe heartbroken. It was supposed to be solved by a team of three, why did only two of THEM get the credit?" — Episode 7: The Swarm Disaster in Three Minutes "Dear audience, we resume our tale where we last left off. The emperor rose to power, the mechanical sect bathed the organic sect in blood, and heroes from every corner rode forth, only to shatter their lances and return empty-handed. Word has it that Aha, the Elation, long absent from the mortal world, plucked a thread of mysterious disturbance and wove it into the calculations of the All-Knowing Nous. That single ripple, like a butterfly's wingbeat, loosed an unknowable variable into the cosmos and unraveled a scheme ten thousand ages in the making. The fearsome emperor slunk off the stage in disgrace, and Aha heaved a contented sigh: 'The deed need not be done by my hand, so long as chaos brings a smile...'" — Episode 10: Aha Weaves a Bewitching Web, the Emperor Tumbles into the Butterfly Trap "In this life, you were reborn into the age of the Interstellar Energy War! Sorry to say, you bit the dust pretty quickly in that brutal conflict that engulfed entire civilizations. With tragedy and comedy thrown so wildly out of balance, the most dependable of all higher beings, the Aeon of the Equilibrium, HooH, finally made a move! But THEY actually called on the most unpredictable Aha? What in the cosmos is going on? Let's dig into how the tricks of the Fools and the Actors played out one after another across the battlefield and how they saved tens of millions of lives. Were THEY pulling the strings? Or did THEY just delegate the dirty work? Those in the know already know. Those who don't... well, they don't." — Episode 12: Secrets About the Interstellar Energy War You Simply Have to Know... ... "According to obscure historical records: during THEIR tenure as an Aeon, Aha received an overall one-star review from THEIR colleagues, which is why THEY're also known as 'Aeon ★ Aha'!" said the comic artist. "So... what exactly is this Aha you keep talking about like?" The question from the audience persisted.

"'Aha'..." The Actor on stage was on the verge of tears. "Back to the beginning, that was a dying soul's last sigh..." "Th—That was THEIR first death..." In the Actor's trembling retelling, a raving beast gave chase to a newborn God. THEY fled across the stars and waded through the abyss, and the starlight itself was snuffed out between the beast's jaws. The pursuit raged on, until Aha scrambled up the "tree" with nowhere left to run, and the beast bit off THEIR head in one clean snap. "It hurts... it hurts so much... I don't want to be Aha anymore... Someone else can have the job..." The Actor's vivid impression sent the crowd into fits of laughter, but no one noticed her eyes, red and teary. "In the wake of it all, the funeral of Elation dragged on and on, thick with the stench of rot..." In the air of pleasure and indulgence, dopamine, dopamine, and more dopamine, until ordinary tricks could no longer satisfy the craving, until spoiled nerves began hunting for a stronger hit. "We hold the final say on what 'Elation' means!" Shameless farces played out across the cosmos, audiences delighting in the suffering of others, as followers of Elation dumped their jokes into the cosmos like taking out the trash. Yet people refused to believe Aha was dead. Instead, they poured their own imaginings over THEIR empty shell. "Chaotic." "Unpredictable." "Evil." "A trickster." "Generous." "Petty." Contradictory, capricious images took the stage one after another. And strangely, they are all a little like that monstrous beast. But beneath the mask, what of the real Aha? Gazing upon the headless divine body, the Actor's tears fell like rain. "Yes, like this... just like this. Life always arrives at its end amid cries of sorrow, only for a newborn's first wail to ring out in its place. How fragile. How sorrowful. Very much... worth celebrating..."

"This is good news, so why the tears?" The Fool burst into laughter, tissues in hand. "If you ask me, the true 'Aha' is the laughter THEY share with humanity!" The first burst of laughter belongs to the infant found by an Actor. She seemed a born master of mischief. Since then, the solemn troupe never knew peace: Mourning dirges were changed into dance music, six-string lutes were swapped for steamed twisted rolls, and gondolas loaded up with sweets. Well, who made her Troupe Master, anyway? The Troupe Master chuckled from her seat at the prow of the Starfroster: "Tell me your stories. Might be they'll make Aha cry, yes?" And so eight Actors gathered beneath a moon shaped like a cookie, and baiting them with just that single opening line, she harvested countless long and enchanting stories. She snapped off a piece of the Abundance, and laughter took root and sprouted: generation after generation of Supplicants offering up miracles for the Phantasmoon Games. And yet, it is not only winners that may seek an audience with The Laughter. Always, she hides in every peal of laughter. She left a Trailblaze Morning Star for that girl who dreamed of what lay beyond the sky. She brought a mask to the young girl lost in the Abundance, and for those drowning in Nihility, she drove back the Dark Sun... She must have spent everything from her lucky investments on this! "Aha, spend enough time associating with mortals, and you'll become one yourself." A fellow Aeon once offered her this advice, and she took it as a compliment. "What kind of The Laughter would I be if I just played the role of my own Path?" But as time wore on, the slow corrosion of Desire upon Elation left her weary. Now, faced with a resurrected beast, she began to doubt: what would greet her if she got onstage? Shock, silence, or applause? She had intended to remain behind the scenes, but then she saw it: the wishes she had sown had begun sprouting. When the lights of the Express lit up her eyes once more, she could only wait on the platform, ready to deliver the first delightful punchline of a new world: "Hello everyone, welcome to Duomension City!"

"So, is this all there is to Aha?" The comic artist winked at the audience. "No: a truly great joke is never fully told!" The Fool sang out, and the lights converged. "The strictest mother of the Aeons, the origin of all Elation..." The Actor wiped away tears and gazed up at the Phantasmoon overhead. The Actor, the Fool, and the comic artist took their curtain calls one by one, until only a hazy, familiar figure remained on stage: "Old friend, Here I come~" Come, return to the moment of dusk with me! Hear the Leviathans howl across the cosmos, watch the nouspores flee through the shadows. Humans as puny as specks of dust lived precarious lives, and yet it was the age when heroes rode as recklessly as wild horses. Akivili's Express flashed across the cosmos like a meteor, and we sped past, laughing and treading on the fanged maw of the beast... Go seek adversaries worthy of mettle, games that while away the hours, and outcomes indifferent to victory or defeat. Go chase laughter that leaves the audience breathless, twists born of fate's whimsy, and songs that ascend our soul. It's not me seeking the Elation: it's the Elation following in my footsteps! The gods were still young in those days: not yet numb, not yet silent as they are now. We blazed towards the end of the cosmos, and there, Akivili vanished at the border of the universe, fading into an insignificant spot of light, and I, too, became a headless God. The cosmos fell quiet once again, but the spark we left behind still waits for the day it ignites a raging wildfire. Now, we take the stage together, just as it began a thousand Amber Eras ago. "Every side of me, every step I have ever taken: these are all me. And yet, none of them is the whole of me." The Actor, the Fool, and the comic artist embrace each other, sighing, weeping, marveling, laughing... They walk toward the first "Aha," and become the last "Aha." "For this unprecedented Phantasmoon Games, I shall offer you an unprecedented miracle!" The full moon rises, and the Supplicants will draw back the curtains and step onto the stage, smiling. "Old friend, have you found your answer? Shh, it's alright if you haven't. It was never the proof that mattered." Self-introduction complete. And so, I, Aha, issue this invitation to everyone across the entire cosmos: "Let us revel in unabated joy, and take the stage for this... final Improv Tour!"
